description: Intent i010 (SNAPSHOT=s03, BRANCH=l2-wireless-ie-tlv) complete. Two reported findings with exact source evidence in snapshots/s03: (1) net/wireless/util.c:2022-2040 skip_ie() — called from ieee80211_ie_split_ric (net/wireless/util.c:2041) with user-supplied assoc IEs (mlme.c:1675 ieee80211_add_before_ht_elems -> mlme.c:1681 skb_put_data, and mlme.c:2369-2372): it consumes the element-id byte under only 'pos < ielen' and reads length byte ies[pos+1] without a >=2-bytes-remaining check (1-byte OOB at pos==ielen-1), advances pos += 2+len unclamped so it can return pos > ielen, and the WLAN_EID_FRAGMENT loop repeats ies[pos+1] with the same missing bound; the overshooting return value is then used by skb_put_data to copy past the end of the user IE buffer. (2) net/bluetooth/eir.c:372-386 eir_get_service_data() — fed by remotely controlled per-adv/ADV EIR buffers (iso.c:2365 hcon->le_per_adv_data, hci_sync.c:1706/1714): it does get_unaligned_le16(eir) on data returned by eir_get_data with *data_len = field_len-1, so dlen==1 (field_len==2) yields a 2-byte read with 1 byte remaining, and eir_len -= dlen (instead of field_len+1) underflows when dlen==eir_len; at iso.c:2365-2374 base_len = dlen - 2 underflows to a huge size_t and only base_len > BASE_MAX_LENGTH is checked before memcpy into iso_pi(sk)->base. Candidates classified: net/mac80211/util.c:2417 ieee80211_ie_split_vendor unresolved (same missing >=2 check, mesh.c caller mitigates); net/wireless/util.c cfg80211_get_p2p_attr, net/wireless/radiotap.c iterator, net/bluetooth/mgmt.c eir_has_uuids, net/bluetooth/hci_event.c eir_get_length, net/bluetooth/eir.h eir_get_data, include/linux/ieee80211.h for_each_element all safe with explicit bounds checks verified. Limitations: NFC/SDP/AMP and driver-level IE parsers not audited; no runtime reproducer compiled (read-only tree), impact expressed as medium-confidence hypotheses.
